title: Colossus
description: You receive [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies this turn.
smart_description: You receive [blue]50%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies for {Amount:plural:this turn|for [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turns}.
notes: Reduces incoming damage from Vulnerable enemies by 50% (multiplicative). Stack count decrements after each enemy turn. Only applies to powered attacks from Vulnerable enemies.
